name: Teething toys/teethers
governing_basis: toy migration (element migration from scraped-off toy material, EU 2009/48/EC Annex II Part III Category III; teething toys are toys and are directly governed by the Toy Safety Directive)
native_basis_label: element migration from scraped-off toy material (mg/kg material)
scope_note: Covers teethers and teething toys a child mouths. General children’s toys without a mouthing-specific role are certified under Category 21 (Children’s Toys).

stricter_unselected.basis: migratable element content; source unit mg/kg
stricter_unselected.scope: oil pastels, crayons, watercolor paints, erasers, correction fluid, correction tape, correction stickers, correction pens, watercolor pens, fountain pens, ballpoint pens, markers, whiteboard pens, fluorescent pens, pencils, inks, pencil cores, and accessible printed, brushed, or coated portions of student articles

iAs.rationale: Contact-product arsenic limits regulate total arsenic; no toy-safety instrument sets an inorganic-arsenic limit. Bounded by the tAs migration ceiling.

stricter_unselected.basis: migratable element content; source unit mg/kg
stricter_unselected.scope: oil pastels, crayons, watercolor paints, erasers, correction fluid, correction tape, correction stickers, correction pens, watercolor pens, fountain pens, ballpoint pens, markers, whiteboard pens, fluorescent pens, pencils, inks, pencil cores, and accessible printed, brushed, or coated portions of student articles

MeHg.rationale: Methylmercury has no formation or migration pathway in a teether. Bounded by the tHg migration ceiling.

Cr-total.rationale: The governing toy-migration instrument (EN 71-3 / Directive 2009/48/EC Annex II Part III Category III) regulates hexavalent chromium specifically (Cr-VI, 0.053 mg/kg migration), not total chromium. The only sovereign total-chromium toy limits (ASTM F963, Mexico NOM-252, China GB 21027 soluble total-Cr, all ~60 mg/kg) are far more permissive than the Cr-VI migration ceiling and would understate control if published as the total-Cr standard. Total chromium is therefore screened, not assigned a published limit; any detectable total chromium reflexes to Cr-VI speciation, which binds at the Category III migration limit.
Cr-total.reference_method: Mandatory ICP-MS total-chromium migration screen (EN 71-3); reflex Cr-VI speciation (EN 71-3 / IEC 62321-7 or equivalent) on any detectable total chromium.

stricter_unselected.basis: organotin (dioctyltin/DOT) content as tin in skin-contact article; source unit percent by weight
stricter_unselected.scope: textile articles intended to come into contact with the skin, childcare articles, and other consumer articles in skin contact (diapers, gloves)

method: HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default, contact-product basis; no cross-basis min)
